policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="chatBody" value="@{
			try {
				var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
				if (body == null || body["agent_session_id"] != null) { return ""; }
				var input = body["input"];
				if (input == null || input.Type != JTokenType.String) { return ""; }
				var text = ((string)input).Trim();
				if (text.Length == 0 || text.Length > 4000) { return ""; }
				var result = new JObject(new JProperty("input", text));
				var previous = body["previous_response_id"];
				if (previous != null && previous.Type != JTokenType.Null) {
					if (previous.Type != JTokenType.String || !Regex.IsMatch((string)previous, "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,200}$")) { return ""; }
					result["previous_response_id"] = (string)previous;
				}
				var sessionHash = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create().ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("session|" + (string)context.Variables["delegatedIdentity"]));
				result["agent_session_id"] = BitConverter.ToString(sessionHash).Replace("-", "").ToLowerInvariant();
				return result.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
			} catch {
				return "";
			}
		}" />
		
			
				
					
					
						application/json
					
					
						{{web-origin}}
					
					{"error":"invalid_request","message":"Expected {\"input\": string (1-4000 chars), \"previous_response_id\"?}. The session is managed by the gateway."}
				
			
		
		
		
		
			application/json
		
		@((string)context.Variables["chatBody"])
